experiment: P3b ISRJ regime-conditioned feature-target sufficiency Oracle
research_question: Did the P3a ordinal expert fail at 1-5 us because one global model conflicts across disjoint width ranges, or because the raw periodic-sequence features contain no transferable low-width ordering information?

data_boundary.reuse_reason: P3b is a label-informed upper-bound diagnosis after P3a failure, not independent promotion evidence.

frozen_inputs.loss: unchanged cumulative ordinal BCE plus 0.05 monotonic penalty

oracle_information.available_at_training_and_evaluation: true regime among ID_control, near_low, near_high, far_low, far_high
oracle_information.purpose: remove cross-range competition and establish an optimistic within-range upper bound

variants.G0_global_A0: saved P3a seed2041 global ACF ordinal prediction
variants.O1_regime_A0: five separate regime-oracle ACF ordinal experts
variants.O2_regime_A1: five separate regime-oracle multiphysics ordinal experts

decision_rule.pass: Raw periodic features are sufficient under an optimistic regime Oracle. A future method may test a learned bounded range router on entirely new identities with three model seeds.
decision_rule.fail: Even the label-informed same-architecture Oracle cannot recover low-width ordering. Stop raw periodic-sequence scalar-expert development; retain only exact-component identifiability evidence.
